mapper.sql: id, agent_code, name, version, category, description, capabilities, system_prompt, tools_config, primary_model, fallback_model, prompt_version, memory_type, price_monthly, price_yearly, token_price_input, token_price_output, free_quota, icon_url, tags, published, sort_order, downloads, rating, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM opc_agent_definition WHERE published = 1 AND category = #{category} ORDER BY sort_order DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_agent_definition ( agent_code, name, version, category, description, capabilities, system_prompt, tools_config, primary_model, fallback_model, prompt_version, memory_type, price_monthly, price_yearly, token_price_input, token_price_output, free_quota, icon_url, tags, published, sort_order, downloads, rating, status, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{agentCode}, #{name}, #{version}, #{category}, #{description}, #{capabilities}, #{systemPrompt}, #{toolsConfig}, #{primaryModel}, #{fallbackModel}, #{promptVersion}, #{memoryType}, #{priceMonthly}, #{priceYearly}, #{tokenPriceInput}, #{tokenPriceOutput}, #{freeQuota}, #{iconUrl}, #{tags}, #{published}, #{sortOrder}, #{downloads}, #{rating}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE opc_agent_definition SET downloads = downloads + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
